Name: Better Journal
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
Better Journal expands the quest journal in vanilla Stardew Valley with tabs for your own custom tasks, heart event reminders, and monster slaying (Adventurer's Guild) goals.

It aims to be streamlined and vanilla-feeling, and does not have complex task management features like automatic completion, repeating tasks, HUD overlays, etc. If you want a sophisticated in-game planner, I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43805]Continued[/url].

[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Toggle Monster Goals on or off[/*]
[*]Toggle Heart event reminders on or off[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with mods that add custom quests[/*]
[*]Mostly compatible with mods that add custom events, as long as they use location triggers like vanilla[/*]
[*]Compatible with all UI recolours[/*]
[*]Compatible with controllers/gamepads[/*]
[*]Compatible with multi-player[/*]
[/list]
